title: Projective Normal Fields: A Convex Optimization Method for Constructing Smooth UDFs
title_zh: 项目ive normal fields: 一种用于构建光滑未符号距离场的凸优化方法

paragraphs.en: Constructing a smooth approximation of an unsigned distance field (UDF) from a raw point cloud is challenging because the input provides neither surface connectivity nor consistently oriented normals. Methods that directly learn a scalar UDF must also handle its non-differentiability on the zero level set and weak supervision away from the samples, which can lead to unstable optimization and spatial artifacts. We introduce Projective Normal Fields (PNFs) , an orientation-free representation and convex optimization framework for estimating bidirectional normals from point positions alone. Each normal axis is encoded by a rank-one projector, which is invariant to normal reversal. We relax the non-convex set of hard projectors to its convex hull: the symmetric positive-semidefinite matrices with unit trace. Each soft tensor defines a local quadratic distance model and retains the relative weights of candidate normal axes. We estimate a coherent PNF by combining local tangent-plane fitting, soft-PCA anchoring, and overlap regularization on a fixed neighborhood graph. With positive anchoring weights, the objective is strongly convex and admits a unique global minimizer. Principal eigenvectors provide bidirectional normals, while the corresponding eigengaps provide spectral confidence indicators. We use these indicators to select and weight directional sources for heat diffusion, followed by Poisson integration to construct a regularized UDF approximation. By separating local geometry estimation from scalar-field construction, PNF avoids directly fitting the non-differentiable UDF. Experiments demonstrate reduced sensitivity to neighborhood size, competitive reconstruction under noise and outliers, and improved accuracy near non-manifold junctions. The project page is available at https://anonymous17777367.github.io/PNF-page/ .
paragraphs.zh: 从原始点云构建无符号距离场（UDF）的光滑近似是一个具有挑战性的任务，因为输入既不提供表面连通性，也不提供方向一致的法线。 直接学习标量 UDF 的方法还必须处理其在零水平集上的非可微性，以及远离样本时的弱监督问题，这可能导致优化不稳定并产生空间伪影。 我们提出了投影法线场（PNFs），这是一种无需指定方向的表示方法，也是一个仅基于点位置估计双向法线的凸优化框架。 每个法线轴都由一个秩一投影矩阵编码，该矩阵对法线方向反转保持不变。 我们将硬投影矩阵构成的非凸集合放宽为其凸包：即具有单位迹的对称半正定矩阵。 每个软张量定义了一个局部二次距离模型，并保留了候选法线轴的相对权重。 通过在固定的邻域图上结合局部切平面拟合、软 PCA 锚定和重叠正则化，我们估计出一个连贯的 PNF。 在正向锚定权重的作用下，目标函数是强凸的，并且存在唯一的全局最小解。 主特征向量提供了双向法线，而对应的特征间隙则提供了谱置信度指标。 我们利用这些指标来选择和加权热扩散的方向源，随后通过泊松积分构建一个正则化的 UDF 近似。 通过将局部几何估计与标量场构建分离，PNF 避免了对非可微的 UDF 进行直接拟合。 实验表明，该方法对邻域大小的敏感度降低，在噪声和离群点条件下仍能实现有竞争力的重建效果，并在非流形交点附近提高了准确性。 项目页面请访问 https://anonymous17777367.github.io/PNF-page/ 。

paragraphs.en: Implicit distance fields provide a compact and flexible representation of 3D geometry for reconstruction, generation, and geometric processing. Signed distance fields (SDFs) are particularly effective when a consistent inside–outside partition is available ( Park et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Ma et al., 2021 ) . For open, non-orientable, or non-manifold surfaces, however, such a partition may be undefined or unnecessarily restrictive. Unsigned distance fields (UDFs) avoid this requirement and accommodate a broader class of surface geometries.
paragraphs.zh: 隐式距离场为重建、生成和几何处理提供了紧凑且灵活的三维几何表示。 带符号距离场（SDF）在存在一致的内外分区时尤其有效（Park et al., 2019；Wang et al., 2023；Ma et al., 2021）。 然而，对于开放、非定向或非流形表面，这种分区可能未定义或过于限制。 无符号距离场（UDF）避免了这一要求，并能处理更广泛的表面几何类型。

paragraphs.en: Constructing a reliable UDF from raw point samples remains challenging. The input provides neither surface connectivity nor consistently oriented normals, and noise, outliers, or nearby surface sheets can make local geometry difficult to infer. Moreover, an ideal UDF is non-differentiable at the surface, while regions away from the samples receive little direct supervision. Methods that learn the scalar field directly must therefore approximate a non-smooth target while controlling its behavior in weakly constrained regions ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . These difficulties can lead to unstable optimization, inaccurate gradients, and spatial artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 从原始点样本构建可靠的 UDF 仍然具有挑战性。 输入既没有提供表面连通性，也没有提供方向一致的法向量，而且噪声、离群点或附近的表面层都可能使局部几何结构的推断变得困难。 此外，理想的 UDF 在表面上是不可微的，而远离样本的区域则几乎没有直接的监督。 因此，直接学习标量场的方法必须在近似非光滑目标的同时，控制其在约束较弱的区域中的行为（Xu et al., 2025）。 这些困难可能导致优化不稳定、梯度不准确以及空间伪影。

paragraphs.en: We adopt a geometry-first perspective: estimate local surface geometry in an orientation-free form before constructing the global scalar field. A tangent plane depends on a normal axis, not on which of its two directions is designated positive. This observation motivates Projective Normal Fields (PNFs) , which represent bidirectional normals using sign-invariant tensors. Relaxing hard normal-axis projectors to soft tensors allows neighboring estimates to be optimized jointly while retaining ambiguity in the local directional evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用一种以几何结构为先的视角：在构建全局标量场之前，先以无方向性的形式估计局部表面几何结构。 切平面取决于法线轴，而与其两个方向中哪一个被指定为正向无关。 这一观察启发了投影法线场（PNFs），它使用符号不变的张量来表示双向法线。 将硬性的法线轴投影器放宽为软性张量，使得相邻的估计值能够被联合优化，同时保留局部方向证据中的模糊性。

paragraphs.en: Our method first estimates a coherent PNF from point positions through joint normal-axis optimization, then uses confidence-guided heat diffusion and scalar integration to construct a regularized UDF approximation. This two-stage design combines geometric evidence across samples and propagates directional information through the surrounding domain. Without requiring a globally consistent normal orientation, it accommodates open, non-orientable, and non-manifold surfaces. Our experiments evaluate sensitivity to neighborhood selection, robustness to noise and outliers, and reconstruction accuracy near non-manifold junctions. Figure 1 illustrates these capabilities on a corrupted Goldfish point cloud, alongside reconstructions from competing methods.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法首先通过联合法线轴优化，从点位置估计出连贯的 PNF，然后利用置信度引导的热扩散和标量积分来构建正则化的 UDF 近似。 这种两阶段设计结合了跨样本的几何证据，并通过周围域传播方向信息。 无需全局一致的法线方向，该方法能够处理开放、非定向和非流形表面。 我们的实验评估了其对邻域选择的敏感度、对噪声和异常值的鲁棒性，以及非流形连接处附近的重建准确性。 图 1 展示了这些能力在受损的“金鱼”点云上的效果，并附有竞争方法的重建结果。

paragraphs.en: Our main contributions are threefold. First, we introduce Projective Normal Fields, an orientation-free representation based on hard normal-axis projectors and their convex relaxation to soft tensors. Second, we formulate PNF estimation as a strongly convex problem combining local tangent-plane fitting, soft-PCA anchoring, and graph-based overlap regularization, with a unique global minimizer under positive anchoring weights. Third, we develop a two-stage reconstruction framework that uses the decoded normal axes and their spectral confidence to select and weight directional sources for heat-based UDF construction.

paragraphs.en: Direct approaches reconstruct surfaces by learning scalar unsigned-distance functions from point-cloud observations. NDF ( Chibane et al., 2020 ) introduces a neural UDF conditioned on sparse point clouds. GeoUDF ( Ren et al., 2023 ) incorporates local geometry through learned combinations of distances to neighboring tangent planes. LoSF-UDF ( Hu et al., 2025 ) learns local UDFs from analytically defined shape functions, providing a lightweight model that generalizes across shapes.
paragraphs.zh: 直接方法通过从点云观测中学习标量无符号距离函数来重建表面。 NDF（Chibane 等人，2020）提出了一种基于稀疏点云的神经 UDF。 GeoUDF（Ren 等人，2023）通过邻接切平面的距离的 learned 组合来融入局部几何信息。 LoSF-UDF（Hu 等人，2025）从解析定义的形状函数中学习局部 UDF，从而提供了一个能够跨不同形状泛化的轻量级模型。

sents.zh: GeoUDF（Ren 等人，2023）通过邻接切平面的距离的 learned 组合来融入局部几何信息。

paragraphs.en: Projection-based objectives constrain distance-field learning through spatial query updates. Neural-Pull ( Ma et al., 2021 ) , formulated for SDFs, projects queries toward input points using predicted distances and gradients. In the unsigned setting, CAP-UDF ( Zhou et al., 2022 ) progressively pulls queries toward the surface under a field-consistency constraint, while LevelSetUDF ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) improves zero-level-set continuity through projection from smoother nonzero level sets. SuperUDF ( Tian et al., 2024 ) combines LOP-inspired projection with a learned geometry prior and sparsity regularization. RMSMS ( Liu et al., 2025 ) uses recurrent multi-step query updates with distance and gradient regularization. These methods share the principle of enforcing consistency between the learned field, query motion, and sampled surface geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 基于投影的目标通过空间查询更新来约束距离场学习。 Neural-Pull（Ma et al., 2021）专为SDF设计，它利用预测的距离和梯度将查询向输入点投影。 在无符号设置中，CAP-UDF（Zhou et al., 2022）在保持场一致性的约束下逐步将查询拉向表面，而LevelSetUDF（Zhou et al., 2023）则通过从更平滑的非零等值集进行投影来改善零等值集的连续性。 SuperUDF（Tian et al., 2024）结合了受LOP启发的投影、学习到的几何先验以及稀疏性正则化。 RMSMS（Liu et al., 2025）采用循环的多步查询更新，并配合距离和梯度正则化。 这些方法都遵循同一原则：确保所学到的场、查询运动以及采样得到的表面几何结构之间保持一致性。

paragraphs.en: Another line of work addresses the non-differentiability of the ideal UDF at the surface by modifying the field representation or its regularization. DUDF ( Fainstein et al., 2024 ) learns a differentiable hyperbolic transformation of the UDF. DEUDF ( Xu et al., 2025 ) combines an unconstrained neural output, normal alignment, adaptive Eikonal regularization, and a sinusoidal network to improve near-surface gradients and geometric detail. S 2 DF ( Yang et al., 2025 ) instead uses a differentiable scaled-squared distance representation with Monge–Ampère regularization. These approaches retain a scalar UDF or a transformed distance field as the primary prediction target.
paragraphs.zh: 另一类研究通过修改场表示或其正则化，解决了理想 UDF 在表面处不可微分的问题。 DUDF（Fainstein 等人，2024）学习了一种 UDF 的可微双曲变换。 DEUDF（Xu 等人，2025）结合了无约束神经输出、法线对齐、自适应 Eikonal 正则化和正弦网络，以改善近表面梯度和几何细节。 S²DF（Yang 等人，2025）则采用了一种带有 Monge–Ampère 正则化的可微缩放平方距离表示。 这些方法仍将标量 UDF 或变换后的距离场作为主要预测目标。

paragraphs.en: Hybrid representations augment distance information with additional geometric or topological cues. HSDF ( Wang et al., 2022 ) jointly learns unsigned distances and an auxiliary sign field to support surface extraction. GIFS ( Ye et al., 2022 ) predicts whether a surface separates a pair of spatial points and uses an auxiliary UDF branch to enhance spatial features. MPF ( Kong et al., 2026 ) separates an unsigned metric field from a smooth phase field, then combines them into a signed implicit function for thin-structure reconstruction.

Moving least-squares surfaces ( Alexa et al., 2001 ; Kolluri, 2008 ) construct local surface approximations, while variational implicit point set methods ( Huang et al., 2019 ; Xia and Ju, 2025 ) recover implicit geometry through variational optimization. These methods provide geometric reconstruction precedents rather than direct neural UDF predictors.

paragraphs.en: Closest-point and vector-valued representations offer another alternative by explicitly encoding the relationship between spatial queries and the surface. The closest-surface-point representation ( Venkatesh et al., 2021 ) predicts the nearest surface point associated with each query, from which unsigned distance and local differential information can be derived. VF ( Mello Rella et al., 2025 ) predicts the unit direction toward the nearest surface point, whereas NVF ( Yang et al., 2023 ) predicts the full displacement vector, whose magnitude also encodes distance. These representations make surface correspondence or directional information explicit, rather than encoding geometry solely through scalar distance values.
paragraphs.zh: 最近点与向量值表示通过显式编码空间查询与表面之间的关系，提供了另一种替代方案。 最近表面点表示（Venkatesh 等，2021）预测每个查询所关联的最近表面点，由此可以推导出无符号距离和局部微分信息。 VF（Mello Rella 等，2025）预测指向最近表面点的单位方向，而 NVF（Yang 等，2023）则预测完整的位移向量，其大小也编码了距离。 这些表示方式将表面的对应关系或方向信息显式化，而不是仅通过标量距离值来编码几何结构。

paragraphs.en: Among geometry-first UDF construction methods, VAD ( Kong et al., 2025 ) is the most closely related to PNF. It estimates bidirectional normals by reducing discrepancies between local projection-distance fields and their gradients across Voronoi bisectors. The optimized directional information is then diffused through the ambient domain and integrated into a scalar UDF. PNF retains this normal-first decomposition but changes the normal-estimation formulation: it jointly optimizes soft normal-axis tensors over a fixed neighborhood graph, without requiring a Voronoi construction. With positive anchoring weights, the resulting objective is strongly convex and admits a unique global minimizer. The distinction therefore lies in the representation and optimization of the local normal field, rather than in the use of diffusion for downstream UDF construction. Appendix F.3 provides a detailed comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 在优先构建几何结构的 UDF 方法中，VAD（Kong 等人，2025）与 PNF 最为相关。 它通过减少局部投影距离场与其梯度在 Voronoi 平分线两侧的差异来估计双向法线。 随后，优化后的方向信息会在环境域中扩散，并整合为一个标量 UDF。 PNF 保留了这种优先处理法线的分解方式，但改变了法线估计的公式：它在固定的邻域图上联合优化软法线轴张量，而无需构建 Voronoi 结构。 在正向锚定权重的作用下，所得目标函数是强凸的，且存在唯一的全局最小值点。 因此，二者的区别在于局部法线场的表示与优化方式，而非在下游 UDF 构建中是否使用扩散方法。 附录 F.3 提供了详细的比较。

paragraphs.en: Stage I estimates a local normal axis at each input point without imposing a global orientation. Since 𝐧 i \mathbf{n}_{i} and − 𝐧 i -\mathbf{n}_{i} describe the same local tangent plane, we represent their common axis by the rank-one projector 𝐏 i = 𝐧 i ​ 𝐧 i ⊤ \mathbf{P}_{i}=\mathbf{n}_{i}\mathbf{n}_{i}^{\top} . This representation removes the arbitrary sign choice. We call the collection { 𝐏 i } i = 1 N \{\mathbf{P}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} a hard projective normal field . Because hard projectors form a non-convex set, we relax them to soft normal-axis tensors { 𝐌 i } i = 1 N \{\mathbf{M}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} in a convex feasible set. We estimate the resulting soft projective normal field by combining local tangent-plane evidence with compatibility between neighboring local distance models. With a fixed graph and positive anchoring weights, the objective is strongly convex and has a unique global minimizer. After optimization, a principal eigenvector provides a hard normal axis, while the corresponding eigengap indicates how strongly the tensor favors that axis.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 I 在每个输入点处估计一个局部法线轴，而无需施加全局方向。 由于 𝐧 i \mathbf{n}_{i} 和 − 𝐧 i -\mathbf{n}_{i} 描述了同一个局部切平面，我们用秩一投影算子 𝐏 i = 𝐧 i ​ 𝐧 i ⊤ \mathbf{P}_{i}=\mathbf{n}_{i}\mathbf{n}_{i}^{\top} 来表示它们的公共轴。 这种表示方式消除了符号的任意性选择。 我们将集合 { 𝐏 i } i = 1 N \{\mathbf{P}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} 称为硬投影法线场。 由于硬投影算子构成一个非凸集，我们将其放宽为软法线轴张量 { 𝐌 i } i = 1 N \{\mathbf{M}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N}，置于一个凸可行集中。 我们通过结合局部切平面证据与相邻局部距离模型之间的兼容性，来估计由此得到的软投影法线场。 在固定图结构和正锚定权重的情况下，目标函数是强凸的，并且存在唯一的全局最小值点。 优化之后，主特征向量可提供一个硬法线轴，而对应的特征间隙则表明该张量对该轴的偏好强度。

paragraphs.en: Stage II uses the decoded axes and their confidence values to construct a global UDF approximation. Confidence-based source selection and weighting modulate the directional information propagated by heat diffusion, and Poisson integration assembles this information into a scalar field. paragraphs.en: This section develops the normal-axis representation and optimization used in Stage I. We first describe hard normal-axis projectors, then introduce their convex relaxation to soft tensors, and finally formulate a graph-based objective for estimating a coherent projective normal field.
paragraphs.zh: 本节将阐述第一阶段中使用的法线轴表示法和优化方法。 我们首先介绍硬法线轴投影算子，然后引入其凸松弛形式——软张量，最后构建一个基于图的目标函数，用于估计相干投影法线场。

The vectors 𝐧 \mathbf{n} and − 𝐧 -\mathbf{n} represent the same unoriented normal axis span ⁡ { 𝐧 } \operatorname{span}\{\mathbf{n}\} , which we encode by 𝐏 = 𝐧𝐧 ⊤ \mathbf{P}=\mathbf{n}\mathbf{n}^{\top} . We call 𝐏 \mathbf{P} a hard normal-axis projector or simply a hard projector . This representation is sign invariant because ( − 𝐧 ) ​ ( − 𝐧 ) ⊤ = 𝐧𝐧 ⊤ (-\mathbf{n})(-\mathbf{n})^{\top}=\mathbf{n}\mathbf{n}^{\top} . Conversely, every rank-one orthogonal projector in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} has this form, with 𝐧 \mathbf{n} unique up to sign. Hard projectors and bidirectional normals are therefore equivalent representations.

paragraphs.en: Appendix A provides the proof. The eigendecomposition gives a direct geometric interpretation: the eigenvectors define candidate normal axes, and the eigenvalues specify their nonnegative mixture weights. A hard projector assigns all weight to one axis, whereas a more diffuse spectrum retains competing directional preferences. We optimize the soft tensors first and decode a single hard normal axis afterward.

paragraphs.en: PCA versus PNF: ambiguous local neighborhoods. PCA estimates a normal axis from the direction of least local point variation. This estimate becomes less reliable when the neighborhood lacks a clear tangent-plane structure. Such ambiguity often arises in three challenging settings: noisy inputs, where perturbations obscure local directional structure; outlier-contaminated inputs, where spurious samples distort the local point distribution; and thin structures, where a neighborhood may contain points from distinct nearby surface sheets. In each case, the neighborhood size k k can substantially affect the PCA estimate. Rather than estimating each axis independently, PNF jointly optimizes the normal-axis field using tangent-plane evidence, soft-PCA anchoring, and compatibility between neighboring quadratic models. Figure 3 shows higher normal-axis accuracy for PNF on the illustrated thin structures and noisy inputs. Table 1 further shows smaller variations in accuracy across the tested neighborhood sizes. These results support the benefit of joint normal-axis optimization when individual neighborhoods provide ambiguous geometric evidence.
paragraphs.zh: PCA 与 PNF：模糊的局部邻域。 PCA 根据局部点变化最小的方向来估计法线轴。 当邻域缺乏清晰的切平面结构时，这种估计的可靠性会降低。 这类模糊性通常出现在三种具有挑战性的情形中：存在噪声的输入（扰动会掩盖局部的方向结构）；存在异常值污染的输入（虚假样本会扭曲局部点的分布）；以及薄结构（邻域可能包含来自不同邻近曲面层的点）。 在这每种情况下，邻域大小 k 都会显著影响 PCA 的估计结果。 PNF 并非独立估计每个轴，而是通过切平面证据、软 PCA 锚定以及相邻二次模型之间的兼容性，联合优化法线轴场。 图 3 显示，在所示的薄结构和噪声输入中，PNF 的法线轴准确性更高。 表 1 进一步表明，在不同测试的邻域大小下，准确率的波动更小。 这些结果支持了这样一种观点：当单个邻域提供的几何证据存在模糊性时，联合优化法线轴更具优势。

sents.zh: 这类模糊性通常出现在三种具有挑战性的情形中：存在噪声的输入（扰动会掩盖局部的方向结构）；存在异常值污染的输入（虚假样本会扭曲局部点的分布）；以及薄结构（邻域可能包含来自不同邻近曲面层的点）。

sents.en: In each case, the neighborhood size k k can substantially affect the PCA estimate.
sents.zh: 在这每种情况下，邻域大小 k 都会显著影响 PCA 的估计结果。

sents.en: Rather than estimating each axis independently, PNF jointly optimizes the normal-axis field using tangent-plane evidence, soft-PCA anchoring, and compatibility between neighboring quadratic models.
sents.zh: PNF 并非独立估计每个轴，而是通过切平面证据、软 PCA 锚定以及相邻二次模型之间的兼容性，联合优化法线轴场。

sents.en: These results support the benefit of joint normal-axis optimization when individual neighborhoods provide ambiguous geometric evidence.
sents.zh: 这些结果支持了这样一种观点：当单个邻域提供的几何证据存在模糊性时，联合优化法线轴更具优势。

paragraphs.en: Confidence as a geometric cue. Besides a decoded normal axis, PNF provides the eigengap confidence c i c_{i} . This quantity measures how strongly the optimized tensor favors its leading axis. During reconstruction, we use confidence to modulate directional source contributions and suppress sources below a fixed threshold (Appendix D ). This reduces the influence of weakly preferred axes without automatically discarding the corresponding input samples. Confidence also provides a cue for locating ambiguous normal axes before surface reconstruction. Figure 5 visualizes the optimized confidence on non-manifold geometry and outlier-contaminated inputs. Low values can occur near junctions with competing axes or around samples with inconsistent directional support. However, confidence is not a point-type classifier: low values alone cannot distinguish junctions, outliers, noise, or sparse sampling, and high values do not guarantee a correct normal.

paragraphs.en: Benchmark and evaluation. The benchmark contains 60 models evaluated under five input conditions: clean samples, two noise levels ( 0.3 % 0.3\% and 0.8 % 0.8\% ), and two outlier levels ( 2 % 2\% and 5 % 5\% ). The underlying model set is the same across conditions. We use ground-truth meshes as references when available and otherwise use the original clean point clouds. Table 2 reports arithmetic means of the per-model errors. We evaluate directed Chamfer distance (CD) and Hausdorff distance (HD) from the reference geometry to the reconstruction, corresponding to the mean and maximum nearest-surface distances, respectively. PNF achieves lower CD and HD than VAD under all five tested conditions. Across all compared methods, PNF obtains the lowest CD in four conditions and the second-lowest CD under 0.8 % 0.8\% noise. GeoUDF obtains the lowest HD in four conditions, while PNF obtains the lowest HD under 0.8 % 0.8\% noise. These results demonstrate competitive performance of the complete PNF pipeline under the evaluated input corruptions.

paragraphs.en: We introduced Projective Normal Fields, an orientation-free representation that separates local normal-axis estimation from global UDF construction. By relaxing rank-one projectors to positive-semidefinite, unit-trace tensors, we combine tangent-plane evidence, soft-PCA anchoring, and overlap consistency in a strongly convex optimization on a fixed graph with positive anchoring weights. The optimized tensors provide normal axes and spectral confidence, which guide directional-source selection, heat diffusion, and subsequent UDF construction. Experiments demonstrate reduced sensitivity to neighborhood size compared with local PCA, competitive reconstruction under noise and outliers, and improved accuracy near the evaluated non-manifold junctions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了投影法场（Projective Normal Fields），这是一种无方向性的表示方法，它将局部法线轴估计与全局 UDF 构建分离开来。 通过将秩为 1 的投影算子放宽为正半定、单位迹张量，我们在具有正锚定权重的固定图上，结合切平面证据、软 PCA 锚定和重叠一致性，进行强凸优化。 优化后的张量提供了法线轴和谱置信度，这些结果指导了方向性源的选择、热扩散以及后续的 UDF 构建。 实验表明，与局部 PCA 相比，该方法对邻域大小的敏感度降低，在噪声和异常值条件下具有竞争力的重建能力，并且在所评估的非流形交点附近精度更高。

paragraphs.en: Following heat-based distance reconstruction ( Feng and Crane, 2024 ; Kong et al., 2025 ) , we use the propagated directions to guide scalar integration on a discretized ambient domain. paragraphs.en: We use the double-covering approach of DCUDF ( Hou et al., 2023 ) . Using a small positive isovalue, Marching Cubes ( Lorensen and Cline, 1987 ) first extracts an isosurface around the target. DCUDF then jointly optimizes its vertices toward the zero level set, using field values at vertices and triangle centroids together with geometric regularization. In our implementation, vertex updates use continuous queries of the propagated directional field rather than relying solely on numerical derivatives of the discretized UDF. For orientable manifold targets, DCUDF can separate the double cover into a single-layer mesh; otherwise, it retains a double-layered geometric approximation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用了 DCUDF（Hou 等人，2023）的双覆盖方法。 通过设置一个较小的正等值，Marching Cubes（Lorensen 和 Cline，1987）首先提取出目标周围的等值面。 随后，DCUDF 结合顶点处的场值和三角形质心处的值，并借助几何正则化，对顶点进行联合优化，使其趋近于零水平集。 在我们的实现中，顶点的更新基于传播方向场的连续查询，而非仅依赖离散化 UDF 的数值导数。 对于可定向流形目标，DCUDF 能够将双覆盖结构分离为单层网格；否则，它将保留双层几何近似。

paragraphs.en: We further evaluate the robustness of different reconstruction methods to variations in input point density (Figure 6 ). The network-based methods included in our experiments generally exhibit degraded reconstruction quality as the number of input points decreases, and may even fail to recover a valid surface mesh under sufficiently sparse inputs. In contrast, our optimization-based approach consistently produces stable reconstructions across a wide range of input point counts. Even with substantially fewer input points, PNF continues to recover coherent surface geometry while preserving fine structures and complex topological configurations. These results indicate that our method is less dependent on a specific sampling density and remains effective under varying degrees of input sparsity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步评估了不同重建方法在输入点密度变化下的鲁棒性（图6）。 我们实验中采用的基于网络的方法通常随着输入点数量的减少而表现出重建质量下降，甚至在输入点极度稀疏时可能无法恢复有效的表面网格。 相比之下，我们的基于优化的方法在各种输入点数量范围内都能持续生成稳定的重建结果。 即使输入点数量大幅减少，PNF 仍能恢复连贯的表面几何结构，同时保留精细结构和复杂的拓扑配置。 这些结果表明，我们的方法对特定采样密度的依赖程度较低，并在不同程度的输入稀疏性下依然有效。

paragraphs.en: Despite their shared sign-invariant tensor representation, the two methods differ fundamentally in how the bidirectional normal field is formulated and optimized.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这两种方法共享符号不变的张量表示，但它们在双向法向场的构建与优化方式上存在根本差异。

paragraphs.en: VAD directly optimizes bidirectional normal vectors by enforcing consistency between local projection-distance fields across Voronoi bisectors. Its Voronoi diagram determines both which fields interact and where their value and gradient discrepancies are evaluated. The Voronoi structure is therefore an integral part of its normal-optimization framework, rather than merely a neighborhood data structure. The resulting optimization is solved iteratively without a reported global-optimality guarantee.
paragraphs.zh: VAD 通过强制 Voronoi 平分线两侧的局部投影距离场保持一致性，直接优化双向法向量。 其 Voronoi 图既决定了哪些场会发生交互，也决定了它们的值与梯度差异在何处被评估。 因此，Voronoi 结构是其法向量优化框架的组成部分，而不仅仅是一个邻域数据结构。 由此产生的优化问题通过迭代方式求解，但并未报告具有全局最优性的保证。

paragraphs.en: PNF instead uses normal-axis projectors as optimization variables and relaxes the rank-one constraint to obtain a convex set of positive-semidefinite, unit-trace tensors. It couples these tensors over a fixed neighborhood graph by comparing the Hessians, midpoint gradients, and midpoint values of local quadratic models. A Voronoi construction is not required, and positive anchoring weights guarantee a unique global minimizer. The optimized tensor spectrum also provides axial confidence, which PNF uses for directional-source selection and weighting during reconstruction. Thus, PNF combines convex soft-tensor optimization with confidence-guided propagation while retaining the high-level geometry-first pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: PNF 转而使用正常轴投影器作为优化变量，并放宽秩一约束，以获得由正半定、单位迹张量构成的凸集。 它通过比较局部二次模型的 Hessian 矩阵、中点梯度和中点值，将这些张量耦合到固定的邻域图上。 无需进行 Voronoi 构造，且正向锚定权重可确保存在唯一的全局最小化子。 优化后的张量谱还提供了轴向置信度，PNF 在重建过程中利用该置信度进行方向性源的选择和加权。 因此，PNF 将凸软张量优化与置信度引导的传播相结合，同时保留了以几何结构优先的高级流程。

Recovering an appropriate single-layer representation requires additional post-processing, particularly for non-manifold or non-orientable targets.
